children: Saudi Air Defense Forces intercepted and destroyed six ballistic missiles launched by the Houthi terrorist militia.
Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, spokesperson of the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, stated that the Air Defense Forces have foiled the Houthi attempt to target Taif and Yanbu.
Al-Maliki affirmed that the escalations and violations by the Houthi terrorist militia will be dealt with firmly.
